reason: All riscv64 CI jobs fail with a solver error: python=3.13[build=*_cp313] does not exist for linux-riscv64. This is an upstream missing dependency, not a code bug. The PR author has explicitly noted upstream dependency PRs on cross-python-feedstock and python-feedstock that must land first. Non-riscv64 failures (linux_64 python3.11/3.13, linux_aarch64 python3.11, macOS python3.10/3.11/3.13) are consistent with the same missing python build artifacts across platforms.
